query: What signals indicate a hardware incident is in the anomaly window?

per_column.name: hardware_component_type
per_column.rationale: Categorizes the hardware involved (server, network, storage, etc.), which is external to whether the incident falls in an anomaly window yet plausibly correlates with anomalous hardware events. Legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: failure_symptom_pattern
per_column.rationale: Describes the observed symptom (failure, not_responding, performance_degradation). This is a characteristic of the incident distinct from the anomaly-window label and carries signal about whether it reflects an anomaly. Predictor.

per_column.name: incident_scope
per_column.rationale: Scope (individual_device vs infrastructure vs shared_resource) is an independent attribute; broad infrastructure scope may correlate with anomaly windows without restating the label. Predictor.

per_column.name: recurrence_flag
per_column.rationale: Whether the issue recurs is a separate signal that can precede/indicate anomalous periods without being a component of the focus label. Plausible predictor, though somewhat proximate.

per_column.name: concurrent_incident_clustering
per_column.rationale: Clustering of concurrent incidents is essentially how an anomaly window is defined/detected. A spike of simultaneous incidents is near-tantamount to being in an anomaly window, so this largely restates the outcome rather than predicting it independently.

per_column.name: escalation_or_rework_indicator
per_column.rationale: Escalation/rework is derived from incident handling and is external to the anomaly-window definition; it can correlate with anomalies. Some post-hoc risk, but generally a usable predictor.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are legitimate, independent attributes of the incident (component type, symptom, scope, recurrence, escalation) that plausibly carry signal about whether it falls in a hardware anomaly window without deterministically restating the label. concurrent_incident_clustering is effectively a near-definition of an anomaly window and constitutes leakage. As a set the features offer moderate genuine predictive leverage beyond the original columns, tempered by the leakage column and the fact that several signals are correlational proxies rather than strong drivers.
